---
name: start
description: Use when beginning a new task or picking up an issue, before refining requirements or planning implementation.
---

# Start work

- Identify the task's source and goal. Read the relevant issue or supplied context and inspect the repository state before making changes.
- Check for existing user changes and preserve them. Do not overwrite or revert unrelated work.
- Read the relevant `.github/skills/` files and project documentation. Read the architecture draft in `README.md` before proposing structural changes.
- Summarize the current understanding, relevant constraints, likely affected areas, and any immediate blockers.
- Do not create or modify remote issues, branches, pull requests, or other GitHub resources. Do not commit or push.
- Hand off to `refine` when requirements need clarification, or to `plan` when the task is clear.
